<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoomEnvironment } from 'three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js';
function createScene(canvas, { mobile = false } = {}) {
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: !mobile, alpha: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, mobile ? 1.25 : 2));
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = !mobile;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xd6e9fb, 60, 170);
const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
scene.environment = pmrem.fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture;
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(35, 1, 0.1, 400);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcfe6ff, 0xb9a98c, 0.9));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1dc, 2.4);
sun.position.set(22, 34, 18);
sun.castShadow = true;
sun.shadow.mapSize.set(mobile ? 1024 : 2048, mobile ? 1024 : 2048);
Object.assign(sun.shadow.camera, { left: -30, right: 30, top: 30, bottom: -30, near: 1, far: 100 });
sun.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.02;
scene.add(sun);
const glow = new THREE.PointLight(0xffc27a, 30, 22, 1.6);
glow.position.set(0, 3, 4);
scene.add(glow);
const std = (color, roughness = 0.8, extra = {}) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness, ...extra });
const M = {
white: std(0xf4f1eb, 0.85),
stone: std(0xe6dfd2, 0.95),
feature: std(0x8a8176, 0.9),
dark: std(0x24272c, 0.5, { metalness: 0.4 }),
wood: std(0x9b6a3c, 0.65),
glass: new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: 0x2a4256, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.04, transparent: true, opacity: 0.34, envMapIntensity: 1.6, depthWrite: false }),
warm: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffd7a1 }),
water: new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: 0x47bde3, roughness: 0.06, metalness: 0, clearcoat: 1, envMapIntensity: 1.8, emissive: 0x0a4d66, emissiveIntensity: 0.25 }),
lawn: std(0xa9c28a, 1),
leaf: std(0x6e9b52, 0.9, { flatShading: true }),
leafDark: std(0x3f6b3a, 0.9, { flatShading: true }),
trunk: std(0x6b4a33, 1),
cloud: std(0xffffff, 1, { emissive: 0xffffff, emissiveIntensity: 0.35 }),
};
const villa = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(villa);
const box = (w, h, d, mat, x, y, z, parent = villa) => {
const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), mat);
m.position.set(x, y, z);
m.castShadow = mat !== M.glass && mat !== M.warm;
m.receiveShadow = true;
parent.add(m);
return m;
};
const lawn = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(160, 64), M.lawn);
lawn.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
lawn.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(lawn);
box(28, 0.4, 20, M.stone, 0, 0.2, 1);
box(5.2, 3.4, 8.4, M.white, -6, 2.1, -1.2);
box(10.4, 3.0, 7.8, M.glass, 2.2, 1.9, -1.2);
box(10.2, 2.8, 0.1, M.warm, 2.2, 1.9, -4.9);
box(0.1, 2.8, 7.4, M.warm, 7.2, 1.9, -1.2);
for (let x = -2.8; x <= 7.3; x += 2) box(0.08, 3.0, 0.08, M.dark, x, 1.9, 2.75);
box(17.5, 0.45, 9.6, M.white, 0.2, 3.62, -1.2);
box(13.6, 2.8, 8.2, M.glass, -2.4, 5.25, 0.6);
box(13.4, 2.6, 0.1, M.warm, -2.4, 5.25, -3.4);
box(0.6, 3.3, 8.8, M.white, -9.2, 5.3, 0.6);
box(14.4, 0.7, 8.8, M.white, -2.1, 7.0, 0.6);
box(15.2, 0.14, 9.6, M.dark, -2.1, 7.42, 0.6);
for (let x = 0.4; x <= 4.6; x += 0.3) box(0.12, 2.7, 0.14, M.wood, x, 5.25, 4.95);
box(13.6, 0.12, 0.12, M.dark, -2.4, 4.1, 5.0); // balcony rail line
box(6.4, 2.6, 5.6, M.white, 3.6, 8.75, -1.6);
box(5.2, 2.0, 0.1, M.glass, 3.6, 8.7, 1.25);
box(5.0, 1.9, 0.1, M.warm, 3.6, 8.7, 0.9);
box(7.4, 0.14, 6.6, M.dark, 3.6, 10.12, -1.6);
box(1.3, 8.2, 10, M.feature, -10.2, 4.3, -1);
box(1.4, 2.4, 1.4, M.feature, -6.5, 8.6, -3.5);
box(11.4, 0.08, 5.4, M.dark, 4.2, 0.42, 7.2);
const water = box(10.8, 0.1, 4.8, M.water, 4.2, 0.45, 7.2);
for (const x of [-3.2, -1.2]) {
box(1.1, 0.25, 2.4, M.white, x, 0.62, 7.4);
box(1.1, 0.7, 0.2, M.white, x, 0.95, 6.3).rotation.x = -0.5;
}
box(0.9, 0.9, 18, M.leafDark, -13.6, 0.85, 1);
box(10, 0.9, 0.9, M.leafDark, -8.5, 0.85, 10.6);
const tree = (x, z, s = 1, kind = 'round') => {
const g = new THREE.Group();
const trunk = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12 * s, 0.22 * s, 2.4 * s, 6), M.trunk);
trunk.position.y = 1.2 * s; trunk.castShadow = true; g.add(trunk);
if (kind === 'cypress') {
const c = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.9 * s, 6 * s, 7), M.leafDark);
c.position.y = 4 * s; c.castShadow = true; g.add(c);
} else {
for (const [dx, dy, r] of [[0, 3, 1.6], [0.8, 3.6, 1.1], [-0.7, 3.5, 1.0]]) {
const f = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(r * s, 1), M.leaf);
f.position.set(dx * s, dy * s, 0); f.castShadow = true; g.add(f);
}
}
g.position.set(x, 0.4, z);
g.rotation.y = Math.random() * 6;
scene.add(g);
return g;
};
const trees = [
tree(-16, -6, 1.3), tree(15, -7, 1.5), tree(17, 3, 1.1), tree(-18, 6, 1.0),
tree(11.5, -4.5, 0.9, 'cypress'), tree(-12, -5, 1, 'cypress'), tree(-12, 3, 0.9, 'cypress'),
tree(24, -18, 2), tree(-26, -20, 2.2), tree(4, -22, 1.8), tree(-6, -26, 2), tree(30, 6, 1.6), tree(-30, 8, 1.7),
];
const clouds = [];
const cloudGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 20, 14);
for (let i = 0; i < (mobile ? 6 : 10); i++) {
const g = new THREE.Group();
const n = 4 + (i % 3);
for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
const s = new THREE.Mesh(cloudGeo, M.cloud);
const r = 2.2 + Math.random() * 2.2;
s.scale.set(r * 1.4, r, r);
s.position.set((k - n / 2) * 2.6, Math.random() * 1.2, Math.random() * 1.5);
g.add(s);
}
g.position.set(-70 + Math.random() * 140, 20 + Math.random() * 14, -30 - Math.random() * 50);
g.userData.speed = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8;
scene.add(g);
clouds.push(g);
}
const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 6.5, 0);
const state = { progress: 0, intro: 0, px: 0, py: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0 };
function place() {
const p = state.progress, e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - state.intro, 3);
const aspect = camera.aspect;
const far = aspect < 0.8 ? 1.75 : aspect < 1.2 ? 1.3 : 1;
const theta = -0.42 + p * 1.25 + state.sx * 0.12 - (1 - e) * 0.9;
const radius = (40 - p * 12) * far + (1 - e) * 55;
const height = 7.5 + p * 4 - state.sy * 2 + (1 - e) * 24;
camera.position.set(Math.sin(theta) * radius, height, Math.cos(theta) * radius);
target.y = 13 - p * 8.5 + (aspect < 0.8 ? 1.5 : aspect < 1.2 ? 3 : 0) * (1 - p);
camera.lookAt(target);
}
function resize() {
const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
if (!w || !h) return;
renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
camera.aspect = w / h;
camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();
let running = true, last = performance.now(), frames = 0;
function frame(now) {
const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05); last = now;
if (running) {
state.sx += (state.px - state.sx) * 0.05;
state.sy += (state.py - state.sy) * 0.05;
for (const c of clouds) { c.position.x += c.userData.speed * dt; if (c.position.x > 80) c.position.x = -80; }
for (const [i, t] of trees.entries()) t.rotation.z = Math.sin(now / 1400 + i) * 0.012;
M.water.emissiveIntensity = 0.22 + Math.sin(now / 600) * 0.06;
glow.intensity = 26 + Math.sin(now / 900) * 4;
place();
renderer.render(scene, camera);
if (++frames === 3) document.documentElement.classList.add('scene-on');
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
return {
setProgress(p) { state.progress = p; },
setPointer(x, y) { state.px = x; state.py = y; },
setIntro(v) { state.intro = v; },
setRunning(v) { running = v; if (v) last = performance.now(); },
renderOnce() { place(); renderer.render(scene, camera); },
};
}
window.createScene = createScene;
window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scene-lib'));
</script>
<script type="module">
const { gsap, ScrollTrigger, Lenis } = window;
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
ScrollTrigger.config({ ignoreMobileResize: true });
gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0);
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const $$ = s => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const mobile = matchMedia('(max-width: 640px)').matches;
const finePointer = matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)').matches;
const nav = $('#nav');
let lenis = null;
if (!reduce && Lenis && finePointer) {
lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.09 });
lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update);
gsap.ticker.add(t => lenis.raf(t * 1000));
lenis.stop();
}
const scrollToEl = el => lenis ? lenis.scrollTo(el, { offset: -10, duration: 1.6 }) : el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
$$('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', e => {
const id = a.getAttribute('href');
const el = id.length > 1 && document.querySelector(id);
if (!el) return;
e.preventDefault();
nav.classList.remove('open');
scrollToEl(el);
}));
$('#burger').onclick = () => nav.classList.toggle('open');
$$('[data-svc]').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
const r = document.querySelector(`input[name=svc][value="${a.dataset.svc}"]`);
if (r) r.checked = true;
}));
function splitChars(el) {
const chars = [];
const walk = node => {
for (const n of [...node.childNodes]) {
if (n.nodeType === 3) {
const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(part => {
if (!part) return;
if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) { frag.append(' '); return; }
const w = document.createElement('span'); w.className = 'w';
for (const ch of part) { const c = document.createElement('span'); c.className = 'c'; c.textContent = ch; w.append(c); chars.push(c); }
frag.append(w);
});
n.replaceWith(frag);
} else if (n.nodeType === 1) walk(n);
}
};
walk(el);
return chars;
}
function splitWords(el) {
const words = [];
const walk = node => {
for (const n of [...node.childNodes]) {
if (n.nodeType === 3) {
const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(part => {
if (!part) return;
if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) { frag.append(part); return; }
const w = document.createElement('span'); w.className = 'wd'; w.textContent = part; frag.append(w); words.push(w);
});
n.replaceWith(frag);
} else if (n.nodeType === 1) walk(n);
}
};
walk(el);
return words;
}

e.preventDefault();

});
let scene = null, introPlayed = false;
const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
const sceneReady = new Promise((ok, no) => { if (window.createScene) return ok({ createScene: window.createScene }); addEventListener('scene-lib', () => ok({ createScene: window.createScene }), { once: true }); setTimeout(() => no(new Error('3D library did not load')), 8000); })
.then(m => {
scene = m.createScene($('#scene'), { mobile });
if (introPlayed) gsap.to({ v: 0 }, { v: 1, duration: 2.4, ease: 'power3.out', onUpdate() { scene.setIntro(this.targets()[0].v); } });
})
.catch(err => { console.warn('3D unavailable, using photo instead', err); document.documentElement.classList.add('no-webgl'); });
if (finePointer) addEventListener('pointermove', e => scene?.setPointer(e.clientX / innerWidth - 0.5, e.clientY / innerHeight - 0.5));
else if (!reduce) gsap.ticker.add(t => scene?.setPointer(Math.sin(t * 0.35) * 0.35, Math.cos(t * 0.25) * 0.15));
const heroChars = splitChars($('#heroTitle'));
gsap.set(heroChars, { yPercent: 115, rotateX: -80, opacity: 0 });
gsap.set('.hero-in', { y: 30, opacity: 0 });
const count = { v: 0 };
gsap.to('#loader img', { opacity: 1, scale: 1, rotateY: 0, duration: 1.1, ease: 'expo.out', delay: 0.1 });
gsap.to('#loader .tag', { opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, delay: 0.5 });
const counting = gsap.to(count, { v: 90, duration: 1.6, ease: 'power2.out', onUpdate: () => { $('#loadNum').textContent = Math.round(count.v); gsap.set('#loadBar', { scaleX: count.v / 100 }); } });
Promise.all([Promise.race([sceneReady, wait(mobile ? 2500 : 4500)]), Promise.race([document.fonts?.ready, wait(1500)]), wait(reduce ? 0 : 1300)]).then(() => {
introPlayed = true;
const tl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'expo.out' } });
tl.to(count, { v: 100, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power1.out', onUpdate: () => { $('#loadNum').textContent = Math.round(count.v); gsap.set('#loadBar', { scaleX: count.v / 100 }); } }, counting.isActive() ? '+=0' : 0)
.to('#loader .mid', { y: -40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.in' })
.to('#loader', { yPercent: -100, duration: 1.1, ease: 'expo.inOut' }, '<0.2')
.add(() => { document.body.classList.remove('loading'); lenis?.start(); $('#loader').style.display = 'none'; })
.to({ v: 0 }, { v: 1, duration: reduce ? 0.01 : 2.8, ease: 'power3.out', onUpdate() { scene?.setIntro(this.targets()[0].v); } }, '<-0.6')
.to(heroChars, { yPercent: 0, rotateX: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 1.4, stagger: 0.035 }, '<0.3')
.to('.hero-in', { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 1.2, stagger: 0.1 }, '<0.4');
setTimeout(() => { if (tl.progress() < 1) tl.progress(1); }, 6000);
});
if (!reduce) {
gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.hero', start: 'top top', end: mobile ? 'bottom top' : '+=120%', pin: !mobile, scrub: mobile ? 0.5 : true, onUpdate: s => scene?.setProgress(s.progress) } })
.to('#heroCopy', { y: -120, opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, ease: 'none', duration: 0.45 }, 0)
.to('.hero-foot', { y: 60, opacity: 0, ease: 'none', duration: 0.25 }, 0)
.to({}, { duration: 0.55 });
ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: '.marquee', start: 'top bottom', end: 'top top', onToggle: () => {}, onLeave: () => scene?.setRunning(false), onEnterBack: () => scene?.setRunning(true) });
ScrollTrigger.create({ onUpdate: s => nav.classList.toggle('hide', s.direction === 1 && s.scroll() > 300 && !nav.classList.contains('open')) });
const mq = gsap.to('#marquee', { xPercent: -50, duration: 28, ease: 'none', repeat: -1 });
ScrollTrigger.create({ onUpdate: s => {
gsap.to(mq, { timeScale: (s.direction || 1) * (1 + Math.min(Math.abs(s.getVelocity()) / 300, 5)), duration: 0.3, overwrite: true });
gsap.to(mq, { timeScale: s.direction || 1, duration: 1.2, delay: 0.3 });
} });

const cards = $$('#hsTrack .card');
const mm = gsap.matchMedia();
mm.add('(min-width: 641px)', () => {
const track = $('#hsTrack');
const dist = () => Math.max(0, track.scrollWidth - innerWidth);
const tilt = () => {
const cx = innerWidth / 2;
cards.forEach(c => {
const r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
const d = gsap.utils.clamp(-1.2, 1.2, (r.left + r.width / 2 - cx) / innerWidth);
gsap.set(c, { rotateY: d * -42, z: -Math.abs(d) * 260, rotateZ: d * -2.5, transformPerspective: 1200 });
});
};
gsap.to(track, { x: () => -dist(), ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#services', start: 'top top', end: () => '+=' + dist(), pin: true, scrub: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true, onUpdate: tilt, onRefresh: tilt } });
tilt();
});
mm.add('(max-width: 640px)', () => {
cards.forEach(c => gsap.from(c, { y: 120, rotateX: -35, opacity: 0, transformPerspective: 900, transformOrigin: '50% 100%', duration: 1.3, ease: 'expo.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: c, start: 'top 92%', once: true } }));
});
gsap.from('#whyGrid > div', { rotateX: -95, opacity: 0, transformPerspective: 1000, transformOrigin: '50% 0%', stagger: 0.14, duration: 1.4, ease: 'expo.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#whyGrid', start: 'top 82%', once: true } });

gsap.to('#rail', { scaleY: 1, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#steps', start: 'top 70%', end: 'bottom 60%', scrub: true } });
const k = mobile ? 0.4 : 1;
const wallEnd = mobile ? 'top 35%' : 'center 55%';
const depths = [-220, 160, -90, 260, -160, 110, -260, 70, 190];
gsap.fromTo('#wall', { rotateX: 52 * k, rotateZ: -12 * k, scale: 1 - 0.26 * k, yPercent: -4 * k }, { rotateX: 0, rotateZ: 0, scale: 1, yPercent: 0, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.wall', start: 'top 90%', end: wallEnd, scrub: true } });
gsap.fromTo('#wall figure', { z: i => depths[i % depths.length] * k }, { z: 0, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.wall', start: 'top 90%', end: wallEnd, scrub: true } });
gsap.fromTo('#ctaMark', { rotate: -18, y: 80 }, { rotate: 12, y: -40, ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '.cta-band', start: 'top bottom', end: 'bottom top', scrub: true } });

gsap.from('#fbig span', { yPercent: 110, rotateX: -70, transformPerspective: 600, stagger: 0.06, duration: 1.4, ease: 'expo.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#fbig', start: 'top 95%', once: true } });
addEventListener('load', () => ScrollTrigger.refresh());
}
if (finePointer && !reduce) {
const dot = $('#cursor'), ring = $('#cursorRing'), label = ring.querySelector('span');
const dx = gsap.quickTo(dot, 'x', { duration: 0.12 }), dy = gsap.quickTo(dot, 'y', { duration: 0.12 });
const rx = gsap.quickTo(ring, 'x', { duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3' }), ry = gsap.quickTo(ring, 'y', { duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3' });
addEventListener('pointermove', e => { document.body.classList.add('has-cursor'); dx(e.clientX); dy(e.clientY); rx(e.clientX); ry(e.clientY); });
document.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => document.body.classList.remove('has-cursor'));
$$('[data-cursor]').forEach(el => {
el.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => { label.textContent = el.dataset.cursor; ring.classList.add('big'); });
el.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => ring.classList.remove('big'));
});
$$('.magnetic').forEach(btn => {
btn.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
gsap.to(btn, { x: (e.clientX - r.left - r.width / 2) * 0.3, y: (e.clientY - r.top - r.height / 2) * 0.4, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power3' });
});
btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => gsap.to(btn, { x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: 'elastic.out(1,.4)' }));
});
const card = $('#logoCard'), media = $('.about-media');
media.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
const r = media.getBoundingClientRect();
gsap.to(card.querySelector('img'), { x: ((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - 0.5) * 24, y: ((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - 0.5) * 24, duration: 0.6 });
});
} else {
$('#cursor').remove(); $('#cursorRing').remove();
}
